svg.text: Built from numbers every frame, not loaded from a mesh, so brakes, surges and collapses can bend it.
● pilot hangs under 38 % of the root chord
48 cells, 12.1 m flat span, root chord 2.75 m, tip 0.45 m:
chord = tip + (root − tip)·√(1 − t²), an ellipse; the leading
edge sweeps back 0.6·t² m towards the tips. Orange nose,
navy tips, darker seams on every rib.
Lines cascade 4 → 1 → 3 → 1 → riser per row (A, B, C, brakes).
NACA-style section as built: ~2 % thick (see caveats)
Brakes pull the rear 45 % of the chord down (squared, so the
trailing edge moves most), more towards the tips. A collapse
folds the outer span down and under about a hinge at 40 %
semispan; it snaps in fast and reopens slowly.
Blended over ~0.4 s at take-off. Arms: 2-bone IK to the toggles.
